executed.finding: PR #420 places time.monotonic() before _buckets_lock. Two callers can sample time in A-then-B order but acquire the lock B-then-A, so the second mutation can use stale time, make tokens negative, issue a false Retry-After, and rewind the bucket last timestamp.
executed.requested_fix: Move the monotonic clock sample inside _buckets_lock and add a deterministic reverse-sample/reverse-acquisition regression asserting last never regresses and an available bucket is not refused.
